assignment_metadata.course: EE-5102/CS-6304 - Advanced Topics in Machine Learning

placeholder_tasks.description: Vision-Language Models and Visual Grounding (SigLIP + Qwen3-0.6B)
Test-Time Compute: Sampling, Selection, and Adaptive Inference

task1_base_model.purpose: Shared starting checkpoint for Task 1 (Full FT, L2-SP, LoRA-4, LoRA-16, OPLoRA-16).

task2_base_models.relationship_to_task1: Task 2 starts from the original untouched Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B checkpoint, NOT from any Task 1 fine-tuned checkpoint.

task3_models.relationship_to_task1: Task 3 live model is Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, NOT Task 1's Qwen3-0.6B.

filtering_rules: Formatted sequence length <= 2048 tokens using Qwen non-thinking chat template
GSM8K test question leakage filter after normalized string matching against query and original_question
First 40,000 eligible examples in preserved source order

gsm8k_leakage_and_eval.purpose: Contamination filtering for training data and zero-shot test evaluation

first_plot_questions_yaml.required_for: Qualitative evaluation (24 prompts, 8 questions x 3 formats)
first_plot_questions_yaml.action_required: Must be provided by student/instructor into shared_assets/inputs/first_plot_questions.yaml

coco_2014_train_val_images.required_for: Task 2 caption alignment and grounding training/eval

coco_2014_annotations.required_for: Captions and instance bounding box annotations

vqav2_complementary_pairs.required_for: Natural VQAv2 complementary pairs and consensus human answers

future_task2_artifacts_needed: Split-isolation manifest (train2014 vs val2014 image-disjoint splits)
Cached frozen SigLIP features (196 patch tokens, final layer norm applied exactly once, FP16)
Task 2 configs, checkpoints, and logs (under task2/ when implemented)

future_task3_artifacts_needed: Lexicographical sort + permuted dev (200) / held-out (800) question IDs (seed 6304)
Scorer / answer normalization versions (math-verify, MathVista rules)
Live-generation config and outputs for 50 MATH evaluation questions

readiness_summary.note: Task 2 and Task 3 are intentionally empty placeholders. All infrastructure, scripts, and tests for Task 1 are implemented in task1/.
